text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in machine learning and Python-based workflows.

I’d be glad to help with your Canva Facebook ads tasks, including logo swaps, small photo edits, and ongoing support if you want someone long term. I work carefully and can help keep your ad creatives consistent and ready for use.

One relevant project I’ve built is a call centre speech analytics pipeline for Vantor Call Centers, where I used Python and the OpenAI API to transcribe calls, separate agent and customer speech, and generate QA summaries for every call. That project processed 2,300 hours of calls and increased QA coverage from 3% to 100%.

If you’d like, I can help make your ad creative edits smooth, reliable, and easy to repeat.
